metadata.description: spike-windows-gate-breakdown's measurement harness: one experiment over one target set, as `just spike-measure`. Spike branch only.

format.command: uv run -q ruff format tools/gate-spike && rustfmt --edition 2021 tools/gate-spike/timed_linker.rs

format-check.command: uv run -q ruff format --check tools/gate-spike && rustfmt --edition 2021 --check tools/gate-spike/timed_linker.rs

typecheck.command: uv run -q ty check --extra-search-path tools/gate-spike --extra-search-path tools/gate-spike/tests --extra-search-path tools/octoprint-env tools/gate-spike && uv run -q ty check --python-platform win32 --extra-search-path tools/gate-spike --extra-search-path tools/gate-spike/tests --extra-search-path tools/octoprint-env tools/gate-spike
